svg.text: Measurement schematic — ESP32 + ADS1115 conductivity probe
20 Hz square excitation · single-ended ADC · 6-point empirical calibration
A0 is bounded 0–3.3 V — no clamps
Lookup key = max of the burst.
All logic 3.3 V. Never apply 5 V
Nets with the same name are joined.
Same net name = same electrical node.
